title: VeriEvolve: Evaluator-First Evolution for Tool-Using Agents
abstract: arXiv:2610.29005v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: A central obstacle to self-improving agents is the absence of a reliable fitness signal for realistic stateful tasks. We introduce \textsc{VeriEvolve}, an evaluator-first evolution framework that constructs this missing evaluation layer before optimizing the agent. From task instruction, VeriEvolve synthesizes instruction-grounded challenge states and an executable evaluator that checks them. During each round of workflow evolution, the evaluator is frozen and serves as the fitness signal. Between rounds, VeriEvolve revises the evaluator by converting the end states of strong and weak runs into a pair of counterfactual test cases.   Across all 30 MCPMark Filesystem tasks, VeriEvolve constructs 30 evaluators with 141 challenge states, achieving 141/141 agreement on the generated suites and 113/122 agreement on held-out states produced by executor agents. Evaluator-guided evolution increases externally verified success from 6/30 to 18/30

translated_title: VeriEvolve：面向工具使用智能体的“评估器优先”进化框架
translated_abstract: 自我改进智能体面临的一个核心障碍是：对于现实中有状态的任务，缺乏可靠的适应度信号。我们提出了VeriEvolve，这是一个“评估器优先”的进化框架，它在优化智能体之前先构建这一缺失的评估层。VeriEvolve从任务指令出发，合成基于指令的挑战状态以及一个可执行的评估器来检验这些状态。在每轮工作流进化过程中，评估器被冻结并作为适应度信号；在两轮之间，VeriEvolve通过将强运行与弱运行的最终状态转换为一对反事实测试用例来修订评估器。在全部30个MCPMark文件系统任务上，VeriEvolve构建了30个包含141个挑战状态的评估器，在生成的测试套件上达到141/141的一致性，在执行智能体产生的保留状态上达到113/122的一致性。评估器引导的进化使外部验证的成功率从6/30提升到18/30。
tldr: VeriEvolve提出“评估器优先”的进化框架，先从任务指令自动合成可执行的评估器和挑战状态作为可靠的适应度信号，再据此进化工具使用智能体，将MCPMark文件系统任务的外部验证成功率从6/30提升至18/30。
en_tdlr: VeriEvolve introduces an evaluator-first evolution framework that automatically synthesizes executable evaluators and challenge states from task instructions as reliable fitness signals before evolving tool-using agents, boosting externally verified success on MCPMark filesystem tasks from 6/30 to 18/30.
